description: This script generates C++ code for load function tables used in texture format handling within the ANGLE project. It processes JSON data to produce a C++ source file with switch-case mappings for different internal formats and data types.

methods.name: load_functions_name
methods.description: Constructs a load function name based on internal format and angle format.

methods.name: unknown_func_name
methods.description: Generates a default load function name for unknown formats.

methods.name: get_load_func
methods.description: Creates a C++ function snippet for loading images based on data types.

methods.name: get_unknown_load_func
methods.description: Creates a load function snippet for unknown or default formats.

methods.name: parse_json
methods.description: Parses JSON data to generate switch-case code snippets and load function mappings.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main script entry point; loads JSON data, generates C++ code, and writes output file.
